metadata.description: Publish, locally read, and safely set up self-contained HTML artifacts on your SFTP web host, including a local stdio MCP adapter.

plugins.name: artifact-sftp
plugins.description: Publish one self-contained HTML file per artifact to an SFTP web host and get a stable private-by-default URL. Includes local artifact read-back, an interactive setup skill that pins and verifies the SFTP host key, and a local stdio MCP adapter.
